caller_asset_contract.notes: Every SDK snapshot, runtime file, speech-engine asset manifest, component licence, entitlement, configuration, cohort, clean reference, baseline, scorer lock, rights record and parity vector must exist at an absolute path and match its declared SHA-256 before a caller may run a denoise-only comparison. Normalization, loudness control, voice processing and streaming scopes are rejected here. No vendor version is pinned because no exact runtime or release id is recorded.

enhancement_profile_requirements.requirement: Run identity/noisy control and an established task-matched baseline.
Score paired SI-SDR and STOI where permitted clean references exist.
Measure clean-speech preservation separately from noise attenuation.
Measure output peaks, invalid intervals and nonfinite failures.
For unpaired speech use a separately labelled predictive screen or authorized listening.
Report alignment, state and memory for the exact runtime.
Report measured content and availability timing for the exact runtime and host.
Keep local runtime, source-reported claims and any vendor output distinct and disclose every fallback.

exact_blockers.requirement: Supply the exact Loudness.ai AI Noise Remover SDK source snapshot (immutable revision or archive), its reported MIT licence text and a per-file SHA-256 manifest. The merged census names the product and reported licence only; no checkout exists.
Supply the exact approved runtime installation with version, build identity, supported platform set and per-file SHA-256 manifest. No runtime binary or package is present.
Supply the bundled speech-engine weights and runtime assets with byte counts, per-file hashes and their own component licences. No weight, graph or binary asset is present or downloaded.
Clear every bundled component and model licence, notice, attribution and redistribution term separately from the reported MIT SDK repository; no licence or notice is present.
Record the exact entitlement, product-use terms, output retention, scoring, publication and redistribution approval. No licence text, grant or entitlement exists.
Document the Python and JavaScript API surfaces, denoise-only invocation, supported rates/channels/frames, content delay, state, reset and drain behaviour before any adapter may be built.

Prove that normalization, loudness control and voice processing can be disabled and that the measured stage is denoise-only. The census says the operation is adjustable; it does not publish the configuration.
Supply a rights-cleared paired speech/noise cohort with consent, source intervals, matched clean references and a frozen per-file manifest. No real audio is present.

Run the identity/noisy control, an established task-matched denoiser baseline, paired SI-SDR and STOI where clean references are permitted, plus clean-speech preservation, peak and invalid output checks under a pinned scorer lock.
Measure alignment, state, memory, content delay and availability timing for the exact runtime and host. No runtime invocation or device clock is available.
Freeze the comparison manifest, failed-item policy and aggregation, then supply one approved exact-runtime parity vector. No manifest or parity result exists.
Complete opt-in provider intake, independent review, resource and deadline evidence, and explicit default/release approval. This package is off by default and makes no release claim.

gates.requirement: The exact SDK source snapshot, runtime version/build, reported MIT licence text and per-file SHA-256 manifest match pins.
An isolated, hash-pinned runtime and every bundled speech-engine asset are admitted with component licences and notices on a recorded platform.
Denoise-only operation is proven, and normalization, loudness control and voice processing are disabled and accounted separately.
Cohort, clean-reference, consent, scoring, publication and redistribution rights are cleared with complete notices.
One approved runtime output matches the frozen parity vector for one exact denoise-only configuration.
The pinned scorer reproduces paired SI-SDR and STOI, identity/noisy control and a task-matched baseline on the frozen cohort with recorded failures.
Explicit opt-in adapter intake, licence review, descriptor review and an independent public-surface decision are complete.
Explicit default selection, resource/deadline evidence and release or public-benchmark approval are recorded; this package is off by default.
